g.text: Recorded end-to-end request timing, in seconds. All panels use the same logarithmic time scale.
Median: solid circles. p95: dashed squares. Each point uses retained completed rows; context placeholders and absent requests are excluded.
Under each size: completed n; 20 planned per cell. With at most 20 observations per cell, p95 is a descriptive tail estimate, not a stable production SLA.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #53667d
